name: ZCA_ES_ENTITY_USAGES
description: This table is used to store the associations that comprise an entity

columns.name: ENTITY_USAGE_UUID
columns.description: the primary key for an entity usage within the meta-data version

columns.name: META_MODEL_VERSION_UUID
columns.description: the meta-data version for this entity usage

columns.name: ENTITY_UUID
columns.description: the uuid of for this entity that this entity usage is for

columns.name: ENTITY_USAGE_NAME
columns.description: the name of for this entity usage that this entity usage is for

columns.name: EO_FULL_DEF_NAME
columns.description: the fully qualified EO definition for the entity usage

columns.name: VO_FULL_DEF_NAME
columns.description: the fully qualified VO defintion for the entity usage that receives customizations, if any

columns.name: TABLE_NAME
columns.description: the table name for this entity usage

columns.name: MANDATORY_FLAG
columns.description: 'Y' to indicate that this entoty usage is mandatory and 'N' otherwise.  If the entoty usage is mandatory, then an inner join will be used during crawling, otherwise a left outer join will be used

columns.name: LANGUAGE_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: the name of the language column if this entity usage corresponds to a translatable entity usage

columns.name: SUBTYPE_COLUMNS_FILTER
columns.description: the json string for a deserialized map that identifies the subtype when the column filter, if any, is satisfied

columns.name: SUBTYPE_COLUMNS_FILTER_EXPR
columns.description: the json string for a deserialized map with an embedded expression that is used to initialize the subtype columns filter.

columns.name: SOFT_DELETE_COLUMNS_FILTER
columns.description: the json string for a deserialized map that identified a soft delete, if any

columns.name: READ_PRIVILEGE
columns.description: NULL if the entity is not secured, otherwise the name of the read privilege, which can be 'read', but, more typically, is a more specific name, such as 'ZCM_VIEW_SALES_PARTY_DATA'

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the row was deleted, otherwise N

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
